tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The blank map sheet.

tokens.name: paper-sea
tokens.usage: Alternate page band and hero ground; the 'sea' around the map. Ink text passes 11:1 (light) and 13:1 (dark).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, the compare tray. In light it sits on paper-sea; on paper it needs a line border.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Table header rows, input wells, zebra rows in Nerd mode.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons. Passes 3:1 against paper in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, numbers, map linework. 12.4:1 on paper (light), 15:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: technical term under a plain label, card metadata. 7:1+ both themes.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Captions, source dates, placeholders. Smallest text that still passes 4.5:1 on paper and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: tomato
tokens.usage: Brand colour: the road in the tick-road mark, the route line, large shapes (24px+). In light it fails 4.5:1 with white text: use action for buttons and text.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (one per view). Pairs with on-action: 4.8:1 (light), 7.4:1 (dark).

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed state.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action fills.

tokens.name: sunflower
tokens.usage: The 'chosen' colour: the destination disc in the logo, the dot on the i, the shortlist count badge, charge stops, the selected switch underline. Only ink text on it (7.9:1).

tokens.name: on-sunflower
tokens.usage: Text on sunflower fills (the shortlist count badge). Always navy, in both themes: 7.9:1.

tokens.name: sunflower-tint
tokens.usage: Money chips ('cheaper to run'), notes. Ink text in light, sunflower text in dark.

tokens.name: meadow
tokens.usage: Land in illustrations and the range-route map. Decorative only: 2.4:1 on white, never text or a lone icon.

tokens.name: meadow-tint
tokens.usage: Positive chips (quality tier 'checked'). Pairs with success text.

tokens.name: sea
tokens.usage: Water in illustrations and the base of the range map.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links and the focus ring. Always underlined in running text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px outline with 2px offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive text: 'checked' data, a good battery-health result. Always with an icon or word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution text: air-cooled pack, single-source data, estimate. On sunflower-tint passes 5.2:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and known faults. Berry, not red, so it never reads as the tomato brand or a call to action.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Error and known-issue panels, with danger text.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First chart series (this car). Provisional: confirm against the dataviz validator before charts ship.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series (comparison car).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series. More than four cars in one chart: use small multiples instead.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Find a used EV that fits your life
styles.usage: One per page: home hero and landing pages. 36px on phones.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title: car, generation, ranking. 30px on phones.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles on car pages and /learn.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: A used EV costs more up front than an old petrol car, and much less every month after.
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs and /learn articles. Max 68 characters a line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Real range in winter is about 330 km, measured by three independent tests.
styles.usage: Default UI and reading text. Never smaller for anything a buyer must read.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Plain-language field labels, buttons, table headers.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: The technical term under a plain label, card metadata, tooltips.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Source lines and dates. Smallest size allowed anywhere.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Headline figures on car pages: monthly saving, real range. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: number-sm
styles.usage: Numbers in tables. Tabular numerals, right-aligned.

styles.name: map-note
styles.usage: Handwritten labels on the range map, illustrations and empty states only. Never for data, buttons or anything a buyer must read to decide.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text gap, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls, between label and term.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding (vertical), chip groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, form field gaps, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections within a page block; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding, big landing-page breaks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, table filter pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, tooltips, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the compare tray, the range map frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Map pins, the detail switch thumb, avatar.

shadow.note: Holiday-map stickers: a short, solid offset shadow in ink, not a soft blur.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Cards and the compare tray resting state.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Popovers, tooltips, menus: the one floating layer.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable. The audience runs to 70.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for reading text.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width; tables may break out to 1440px.
